Masking widespread rural seatbelt non-compliance as mere bad luck prevents necessary community behavioral shifts.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing physical cause (lack of seatbelts) with metaphysical fate (pure tragedy).

Social Physics Analysis:
Actors engage in passive neglect rather than active malice, substituting structural safety education with post-hoc sorrow.

When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil through normalized negligence.

The Unavoidable Truth: Unbuckled minor passengers face vastly magnified fatality risks in routine collisions.

The Unavoidable Lie: Fatal vehicle ejections are purely unpredictable acts of nature.
